historicalTransactions.suitabilityForBacktesting: HIGH - Full market transaction history with exact purchase prices, market values, overbids and dates.

rivalsAudit.suitabilityForBacktesting: HIGH - Full team-level points, squad values, active/injured starter rosters, tactical formations, and financial debt states across all 10 clubs.

playerPointHistories.suitabilityForBacktesting: HIGH - Multi-season official Comunio historical points per player for calibrating Bayesian priors, season PPM decay, and position benchmarks.

matchdayPredictions.suitabilityForBacktesting: MEDIUM - Lineup projection records with confirmed starting 11 expected points before matchday deadlines.

squadSnapshots.suitabilityForBacktesting: HIGH - Player positions, current prices, availability, yellow cards, injury flags, and multi-season points.

newsFeed.suitabilityForBacktesting: MEDIUM - Timestamped transfer announcements and signing valuations across the entire league.

benchTrends.suitabilityForBacktesting: LOW - Single current snapshot of bench vs starter momentum points.

auditLogs.suitabilityForBacktesting: MEDIUM - Bot execution telemetry, bid placements, offer evaluations, and HTTP action timestamps.

leakageControls: All historical prediction evaluations use only data timestamps prior to the target matchday deadline
Player predictions use prior season points and pre-matchday averages only
Team forecast walk-forward tests use progressive expanding windows (J1-J2 -> J3, J1-J3 -> J4, J1-J4 -> J5)
Zero future scoring information is accessible to training/calibration routines
